items: Informed consent: tell participants the purpose and get their permission before involving them.
Confidentiality: keep participants' personal information and answers private.
Integrity: be honest and transparent; never falsify data, plagiarize or misrepresent findings.
Respect for participants: treat them with respect and make sure the research does not harm them.
Avoiding bias: work fairly and base conclusions on the evidence.
